airports.name: Philip S. W. Goldson Intl (Belize City)

cleanup.barriers: Few booms; the Belize Barrier Reef breaks up but does not stop mats reaching caye shores.
cleanup.cleanup: Village councils and Sargassum Task Force crews rake public beaches on Ambergris and Caye Caulker during heavy years.
cleanup.resort: Upscale resorts rake frontage daily; smaller properties rely on hand crews.
cleanup.speed: Frontage usually cleared by mid-morning; shallow backreef water can stay tea-colored for days.

notes: Petty theft and crime concentrated in Belize City; cayes and Placencia generally calmer
Use licensed guides for reef and dive trips; check boat safety gear
Golf carts are the main transport on Ambergris; roads unlit at night

tourism: Hol Chan Marine Reserve & Shark Ray Alley
